title: The Upside Thrust Is There and Waiting for One Thing
speaker: Brent Kochuba (SpotGamma), with tastylive hosts

macro_themes.view: 10-year at 5.3% keeps equities stuck; the upside thrust is there but needs cooling macro data/rates.
Upside realized vol exceeds downside; call volumes contracted, traders waiting for an all-clear to pile into upside.
VIX will price the Nov 3 election and stay somewhat elevated versus ~10 realized vol.

calls.condition: If rates/macro data cool off, the upside thrust seen Friday after jobs data can resume.
calls.reason: Market holds right-tail risk; upside realized vol higher than downside; call buying suppressed by higher rates rather than downside bets.
calls.quote: the ups thrust in this market, it's it's there and it's waiting. It just needs, you know, some cooling of the macro data.

calls.reason: Bank upgrades and launches; positive gamma gives stability with mean-reverting chips higher; call wall 170-200; IV near lows (~50%, IV rank ~10) so call buying makes sense; hosts hold Jan short 125 put/long 250-300 calls.
calls.quote: I think it has legs. I think that you can kind of get again 170 before you get a little bit of a harder rejection.

calls.reason: NVDA implied vol rank near zero, lowest of the year; cheap long options to express either upside or downside market view.
calls.quote: the vol in Nvidia just seems like kind of a gift for uh playing either side

calls.reason: EWZ up 12-13% with call implied vol spiking; expects pace of upside to slow, suggests broken-wing call flies to monetize call skew.
calls.quote: I believe that the pace of change, particularly for us for an index like that, uh is is likely to slow down

calls.reason: VIX-to-realized spread of 5-6 pts vs typical 3.5 reflects election premium, which should hold and keep VIX elevated.
calls.quote: that's going to hold, which is going to keep the VIX I think even a bit more elevated.

notes: Date implied: references Friday's jobs data, guest normally on Tuesday 'tomorrow', banks report 'next week on the 13th' -> Mon 2026-10-05 (listing 2026-10-06). 10y at 5.3% noted without forecast. EWZ bias is a vol/pace view, recorded neutral. Tesla mentioned only in passing.
